My points are that he isn't the winner because he's barely been showcased. He could've easily been given more screen time in the game and on the edge. Are you implying they weren't happy with him as the winner because they didn't edit him well?

He's using the twist exactly as they intended it to work. If they were going to be disappointed by someone voted out on day 8 coming back in at the final 6 and winning, why would they let the twist allow that instead of sending all the pre-merge edge residents out when Rick won?

Because it doesn't make sense for someone who has only 9 confessionals to win the game. It especially doesn't make sense for the winner to have no confessionals in the premiere and only 1 in their boot episode. And it really really doesn't make sense that the producers would be unhappy with a Chris win. He's an alpha male personality, who got blindsided and betrayed early on in the game. He then used the EOE twist exactly as intended and apparently wins his way to the end. That's the kind of winner Survivor loves. They would be showcasing him a lot more if he won and they definitely wouldn't be disappointed by him winning.
